brian-customer: Hey team — our usage export CSV for Feb 14-16 looks short by ~45k tokens vs the dashboard/invoice. Export id: s3://redwood-exports/brightleaf/exports/2026-02-14_2026-02-16/20260216_2312.csv :worried:

maria: Sorry about that, we're looking. Can you confirm the export id (thanks) and whether you still have the original download?

brian-customer: That's the one I pasted above. I re-downloaded to confirm, same counts.

maria: Thanks — assigning to eng-analytics @devin to triage.

devin: I pulled the CSV. Header looks normal but rows around 02:12-03:05 UTC are absent. Quick CSV snippet:
```
date,customer_id,model,tokens
2026-02-14T02:10:00Z,brightleaf,gpt-3x,1024
# <-- nothing until 2026-02-14T03:05:00Z
2026-02-14T03:05:00Z,brightleaf,gpt-3x,512
```

devin: Checking S3 & exporter logs — I see shard commit files for most shards but shard-67 has no commit marker for that window.

oliver: From billing side: invoice shows the higher token count; dashboard ingestion (reads raw events) has the rows, so the export pipeline is the outlier.

devin: Reproduced locally — exporter-worker-12 restarted at 2026-02-14T02:11:43Z with OOM. On restart the shard commit short-circuit used a `last_committed_sequence==null` guard and skipped writing the commit marker. Downstream export generator then treated that shard as already processed and dropped rows.

maria: That sounds like a bug. Is there a quick query to find other affected customers/shards?

devin: Yes, run:
```
SELECT shard_id, min(event_time) as start_ts, max(event_time) as end_ts
FROM raw_usage.events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-14' AND '2026-02-15'
GROUP BY shard_id
HAVING (max(event_time) - min(event_time)) > interval '1 hour'
```
This highlights shards with a hole. In our case shard-67 shows a 02:12->03:05 gap.

devin: Root cause: exporter OOM + commit-marker write race. Patch in PR #987 (exporter: ensure commit marker write on hot restart). Deploying to staging now, then to prod.

maria: Remediation plan?

devin: 1) Run backfill job to reprocess raw events for shard-67 window (job: backfill-exports/INC-4321) — starting now.
2) Reconcile and regenerate CSV rows, append to customer's export.
3) Re-upload fixed CSV and notify customer + account manager.

export-bot: Backfill job backfill-exports/INC-4321 submitted by devin. Job id: job-7764. Status: RUNNING

brian-customer: Thanks. Appreciate the quick response. Please CC our account manager when you re-upload.

maria: Will do — tagging @oliver for billing credit evaluation if needed. :thumbsup:

devin: Update: backfill finished. I verified ~47,312 tokens re-added for Brightleaf. Regenerated CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-exports/brightleaf/exports/2026-02-14_2026-02-16/20260216_2312.fixed.csv

oliver: Checked reconciliation — we won't amend the historic invoice, but we will apply a credit for the delta on the next billing cycle and note REF INC-4321.

brian-customer: Got the file and confirmed numbers match dashboard now. Thanks everyone! :tada:

maria: Closing once billing confirms the credit posted. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
